scope: Six bounded cold Chromium authenticated synthetic-fixture mobile page samples. Fresh context, disabled HTTP cache, service workers blocked/bypassed, CPU4/network150ms/200000Bps. Same-origin browser requests are not intercepted by Playwright; only external-origin requests are aborted. Native health GET body-completion latency is compared with a0ms control after sample collection; unmet calibration invalidates the4s network-goal claim. Document TTFB alone cannot calibrate browser emulation. Layout-shift sources and header/main geometry are captured without node text. Readiness includes actual data and meaningful DOM; headings alone do not count. Observed LCP is bounded to1200ms after data readiness and is not field LCP/INP. Cookie banner retained, only synthetic authentication and onboarding test state added. No PDFs, invoice creation or external production providers exercised.

publication.scope: Sanitized bounded summary with node geometry only; no node text, fixture context or credential values copied.
